candidates.description: This vector activates for mixed-script subword tokens containing Thai characters, Latin letters, and symbols.
This feature vector represents the Thai consonant letter "ต" (to tao) appearing in various morphological and phonetic contexts.
This vector activates strongly for common Thai words and subword tokens.
This feature vector represents Thai locative and prepositional morphemes indicating spatial or temporal position.
This vector represents the Thai consonant 'ก' (ko kai) combined with various vowel signs, tone marks, and other characters.
This feature vector activates on common Thai syllable endings, suffixes, and functional morphemes.
This vector activates on various subword tokens and non-English scripts across multiple languages without a unified semantic theme.
This vector activates for terms and roots associated with ancient Roman history and civilization, alongside unrelated noisy tokens.
This vector represents common Latin-derived suffixes and names ending in the nominative masculine singular "-us".
This feature activates on proper nouns, placenames, and architectural structures across multiple languages.
